dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Phew, looks like the orders are just about done!

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Just some orders for souvenirs. Now that the resort's open for business, we're running out of stock for a lot of our merchandise, including our dolls.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: But thanks to you, we'll be able to complete all our orders without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: This is the resort's paint workshop. We're responsible for providing paints for graffiti, as well as coloring a few dolls and souvenirs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you managing okay by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Oh, I've got a trainee and some Asha around to help. Asha love colors, and they love playing with colors, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: The fact that this workshop can satisfy the resort's paint needs is all thanks to those little fellas.
